opportunities.name: Spirit blade AP attacker
opportunities.objective: Test spirit blade ap attacker against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: A champion-crossing Twilight Assault increases the three empowered attacks' max-health magic damage and grants 50% attack speed; AP increases that percentage. Nashor plus Dusk and Dawn adds separate magic on-hits, while Visage supports Ki Barrier and the build retains a large AP-scaled global R shield.
opportunities.requiredState: Drag the blade through a champion and land all three attacks.
opportunities.failure: Bad blade positioning leaves weaker Q and the energy budget limits repeated E.
opportunities.test: Compare crossed and uncrossed Q attacks and R shield size.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Three empowered attacks are a finite charge budget, not a permanent AP on-hit buff.

opportunities.name: Health physical blade bruiser
opportunities.objective: Test health physical blade bruiser against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Shadow Dash deals physical damage with a source-health term; Titanic and Bloodmail turn purchased/earned health into attack pressure and AD. Q still supplies magic percent-health damage, while Visage supports shields and Heartsteel must be earned through close champion contact.
opportunities.requiredState: Record realistic Heartsteel stacks and maintain Q energy restoration.
opportunities.failure: No attack-speed purchase or spell haste can lose extended trades.
opportunities.test: Compare E physical damage and three Q attacks at matched stacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Shen uses energy; mana items and Manaflow cannot solve his resource limits.

ruledOut.reason: Three empowered attacks are a finite charge budget, not a permanent AP on-hit buff.

unknowns: Proc effectiveness and ordering need a controlled current-patch test; source statFormula IDs and helper records do not establish live dispatch.

builds.name: Spirit blade AP attacker
builds.summary: Test spirit blade ap attacker against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test spirit blade ap attacker against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: A champion-crossing Twilight Assault increases the three empowered attacks' max-health magic damage and grants 50% attack speed; AP increases that percentage. Nashor plus Dusk and Dawn adds separate magic on-hits, while Visage supports Ki Barrier and the build retains a large AP-scaled global R shield.
testPlan: Required state: Drag the blade through a champion and land all three attacks.
Compare crossed and uncrossed Q attacks and R shield size.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Bad blade positioning leaves weaker Q and the energy budget limits repeated E.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Three empowered attacks are a finite charge budget, not a permanent AP on-hit buff.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Spirit Visage, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Shen recalls his Spirit Blade. Enemies hit by the pull are Slowed by [25 / 30 / 35 / 40 / 45]% while moving away from Shen for the next [2] seconds.

Additionally, Shen's next [3] Attacks deal an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=10, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 4, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 10, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] plus [(2 / 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 / 4 + (0.015) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage. If Shen hit an enemy champion with the Spirit Blade, the damage is increased to [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=10, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 4, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 10, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] plus [(5 / 5.5 / 6 / 6.5 / 7 + (0.02) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage and he gains [50]% Attack Speed for those Attacks.

Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or this Ability recovers [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=30, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 4, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] Energy.

Active: Shen dashes, Taunting champions and jungle monsters for [1.5] seconds and dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.11) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Shen gains [UNRESOLVED(GameCalculationConditional; see calculationRaw)] Shield for [2.5] seconds after using an Ability. This effect has a [11] second Cooldown, reduced by [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=4, perLevel=0.235, changes=[{"mLevel": 19, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.125, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds when one of Shen's Abilities successfully affects an ally or enemy.

Shen has a Spirit Blade that his other Abilities use.

Shen grants an allied champion anywhere on the map between [120 / 220 / 320 + (0.15) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (1.35) × AP] and [(120 / 220 / 320 + (0.15) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (1.35) × AP) × (1.6)] Shield based on their missing Health for [5] seconds (max Shield at 60% missing Health). After channeling for [3] seconds, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his Spirit Blade.

Shen creates a defensive zone at his Spirit Blade for [1.75] seconds. Attacks against allied champions in the zone are blocked. 

If there are no champions to protect in the zone when it starts, it will wait for up to [2] seconds.
